title: Mensuration and Trigonometry Unit Test
subject: math
unitTitle: Sectors, pyramids, spheres and trigonometric ratios

items.prompt: A sector has angle 90 degrees in a circle of radius 8 cm. What is its arc length?

points.text: Writes the arc as the angle fraction of the circumference, 90/360 x 2 pi x 8
Gives the arc length as 4 pi cm

items.prompt: Find the volume of a sphere of radius 3 cm, in terms of pi.

points.text: Writes the sphere volume as 4/3 pi r cubed before substituting r = 3
Gives the volume as 36 pi cubic centimetres

items.prompt: In the 3-4-5 triangle, angle theta has opposite side 3 and hypotenuse 5. What is sin theta?

points.text: States sin theta as opposite over hypotenuse

items.prompt: In triangle ABC, side a = 4 is opposite angle A = 30 degrees, and angle B = 60 degrees. Use the sine rule to calculate side b.

points.text: Writes the sine rule pairing a with sin A and b with sin B before substituting
Rearranges to (4 x 0.8660) / 0.5 and gives b as about 6.93

levels.label: Secure
levels.descriptor: Working names the fraction, formula or pairing first, then applies it in a justified sequence.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The method is broadly sound but a fraction, power or pairing step is asserted without justification.

levels.label: Beginning
levels.descriptor: Formulae or ratios are written without naming what each part represents.
